audits.title: CoinList Token Sale Fund Updates
audits.summary: Audit of the changes to CoinList's TokenSaleFund Solidity contract. TokenSaleFund is a custodial contract that holds users' contributions during a token sale, with backend-controlled flows to commit and lock funds, remit refunds, and finally distribute the remaining balances to a recipient such as the sale partner.

audits.title: ZIGChain
audits.summary: Audit of the ZIGChain Cosmos SDK application, covering the app, wasmbinding and custom x/ modules. ZIGChain is a Cosmos SDK–based blockchain with a native ZIG token, a factory module for namespaced token issuance, an AMM dex module, and a tokenwrapper module bridging to Axelar and EVM chains.

audits.title: Neutron Auction and Undelegations Phase 1
audits.summary: Audit of the Neutron auction CosmWasm contract. It runs a time-bounded deposit auction, then lets the owner settle in batches, allocating a fixed USDC budget pro rata to each participant's share of deposits and burning the deposited claim tokens, after which users claim their USDC.

audits.title: Neutron Auction and Undelegations Phase 2
audits.summary: Audit of the Neutron v11 chain upgrade. It moves Neutron to the native Cosmos SDK governance module, replaces x/revenue, x/feeburner and adminmodule with gov, mint and distribution, migrates the puppeteer contract to auth-proxy, and schedules x/cron tasks for the undelegations manager contract.

audits.title: Warren (Tezoro)
audits.summary: Audit of the v1.1 Solidity contracts of Warren (formerly Tezoro). Tezoro is an ERC-4626 vault that allocates deposits across lending protocols such as Aave V3, Compound V3, Spark, Morpho Blue and Fluid, with keeper-driven rebalancing and a performance fee charged on yield above a high water mark.

audits.title: CoinList TokenSwap
audits.summary: Audit of CoinList's TokenSwap Solidity contracts and their Superstate integration. TokenSwap is a shared base for token swap integrations that handles fees and per-user swap totals, and Superstate.sol implements it for a Superstate "buy the dip" market, checking eligibility and forwarding the minted tokens to the caller.

audits.title: CoinList Pull 12
audits.summary: Audit of the changes in pull request 12 of CoinList's onchain repository, which holds Ethereum contracts supporting token sale and swap operations. The in-scope Solidity code covers a general swap module (Soms) and an Ondo-specific swap module that interfaces with external manager and RWA contracts.

audits.title: Zama
audits.summary: Cryptography audit for Zama, focused on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). Zama builds a confidential blockchain protocol.

audits.title: Anyflo Move Contracts and Workers
audits.summary: Audit of Anyflo's Move smart contracts and associated workers. Anyflo is a neutral orchestration layer for stablecoin payments, offering institutions one integration to send, receive and settle across stablecoins and chains.

audits.title: Injective Audit Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to Injective's Cosmos SDK codebase, written in Go. Injective is a layer 1 blockchain infrastructure for finance, built for tokenization, perpetuals, stablecoins and institutional onchain markets.

audits.title: Anyflo EVM Contracts
audits.summary: Audit of Anyflo's Solidity smart contracts for EVM chains. Anyflo is a neutral orchestration layer for stablecoin payments: a single integration to send, receive and settle across any stablecoin and chain, built for institutions.

audits.title: Monaco
audits.summary: Audit of the Monaco smart contracts. Monaco is a trading platform that brings spot, perpetuals and prediction markets across asset classes together in one place.

audits.title: Injective
audits.summary: Security review of the Injective chain, a Cosmos SDK codebase written in Go. Injective is a layer 1 blockchain built as infrastructure for finance, supporting tokenization, perpetuals, stablecoins and institutional onchain markets.

audits.title: ZIGChain Pull 14
audits.summary: Audit of the changes in ZIGChain pull request 14, written in Go. ZIGChain is a Cosmos SDK–based blockchain with a native ZIG token and application modules for asset issuance, trading and external bridging.

audits.title: Divigent MCP SDK
audits.summary: Audit of the Divigent MCP SDK for AI agents. Divigent is the treasury layer for x402 agent wallets on Base, providing adaptive reserves, just-in-time recall, venue monitoring and yield on idle USDC.

audits.title: IBC
audits.summary: Audit of the Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) protocol. IBC is a blockchain interoperability protocol used by more than 115 chains for cross-chain communication.

audits.title: Divigent
audits.summary: Audit of the Divigent smart contracts. Divigent provides a treasury layer for x402 agent wallets on Base, with adaptive reserves, just-in-time recall, venue monitoring and yield on idle USDC.

audits.title: Totalis
audits.summary: Audit of the Totalis smart contracts. Totalis is a multi-outcome prediction market trading platform that lets traders express multiple worldviews in a single leveraged position.

audits.title: Azura
audits.summary: Audit of the smart contracts behind Azura, an onchain trading platform.

audits.title: MANTRA Chain
audits.summary: Audit of MANTRA Chain, a Cosmos SDK chain written in Go. MANTRA is an EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain for real world assets, designed to be capable of adhering to real-world regulatory requirements.

audits.title: IBC v2 Eureka
audits.summary: Audit of IBC v2 (Eureka), spanning Go code for Cosmos SDK chains and Solidity contracts for Ethereum. IBC is a blockchain interoperability protocol used by more than 115 chains for cross-chain communication.

audits.title: BeeZee
audits.summary: Smart contracts audit for BeeZee. BeeZee Network is a Cosmos SDK-based DeFi blockchain with IBC support, powered by the BZE coin, where users can create tokens, trade on a DEX and stake for rewards.

audits.title: Injective Updates
audits.summary: Review of a further set of updates to Injective's Go-based Cosmos SDK chain. Injective is a layer 1 blockchain for finance, used for tokenization, perpetuals, stablecoins, AI finance and institutional onchain markets.

audits.title: Structured maxBTC EVM Oracle Contracts
audits.summary: Audit of Structured's maxBTC oracle contracts for EVM chains, written in Solidity. maxBTC is a cross-chain yield strategy and tokenization system for Bitcoin.

audits.title: SolvBTC Stellar Bridge
audits.summary: Audit of changes to the SolvBTC Stellar bridge contracts, Soroban smart contracts written in Rust. Solv Protocol offers BTC holders a suite of financial services, including lending, liquid staking, yield generation and fund management.

audits.title: Structured maxBTC CosmWasm and Solana Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to Structured's maxBTC Solana programs (jupiter-helper, wormhole-helper, waitosaur) and CosmWasm contracts. maxBTC is a cross-chain yield and tokenization system in which Neutron mints and burns the token while strategy legs on Binance and Solana deploy and hedge assets.

audits.title: Structured spdBTC Whitelist
audits.summary: Audit of the whitelist changes to Structured's spdBTC Solidity contract. Structured Private Deposit is an ERC-4626 vault that accepts WBTC and issues spdBTC 1:1, transfers deposits to a designated custodian, and includes deposit limits, address blacklisting and a pause mechanism.

audits.title: CoinList Token Sale Fund
audits.summary: Audit of CoinList's TokenSaleFund Solidity contract, which custodies user contributions for a token sale. Backend-controlled accounts commit and lock funds, designated accounts can remit refunds, and the owner finally transfers the remaining balances to a recipient such as the sale partner.

audits.title: The Graph
audits.summary: Audit of smart contracts for The Graph. The Graph is an indexing protocol for organizing blockchain data and making it easily accessible to applications through GraphQL.

audits.title: Snowfork Snowbridge Fiat-Shamir BEEFY Changes
audits.summary: Audit of the Snowbridge change adding a non-interactive, Fiat-Shamir based BEEFY verification path to the Solidity BeefyClient alongside the RANDAO-based two-phase protocol. Snowbridge is a trustless bridge between Polkadot and Ethereum built on light clients.

audits.title: Structured maxBTC EVM
audits.summary: Audit of Structured's maxBTC Solidity contracts for EVM chains. maxBTC is a cross-chain yield strategy and tokenization system for Bitcoin, with the token minted and burned on Neutron.

audits.title: Acurast Compute Pallet
audits.summary: Audit of the Acurast compute pallet, a Substrate pallet written in Rust. Acurast is a decentralized compute network powered by phones, designed to run workloads without reliance on centralized servers.

audits.title: Stellar Core Protocol 24
audits.summary: Audit of the Protocol 24 changes to stellar-core, the C++ node behind the Stellar network. Stellar is an open network for fast, low-cost payments and asset issuance, secured by the Stellar Consensus Protocol and extended with Soroban smart contracts in Rust and Wasm.

audits.title: Volta Protocol Soroban
audits.summary: Audit of Volta's Soroban smart contract in Rust, which implements threshold-governed multisig control with rule-based call authorization. Owners propose configuration changes, upgrades and per-user rules, and users whose rules match can execute permitted cross-contract calls.

audits.title: Structured maxBTC ERC20 for Eureka Bridge
audits.summary: Audit of three Solidity contracts for Structured's maxBTC: an upgradable ERC20 whose minting and burning are controlled by the Eureka bridge to represent maxBTC across Neutron and Cosmos, a WETH-like ETH wrapper for automated bridging, and a fixed-rate token converter.

audits.title: Stellar Core Protocol 23
audits.summary: Audit of the Protocol 23 changes to stellar-core and the Soroban host environment, including the overlay, crypto, SCP and transactions modules. Stellar is an open network for fast, low-cost payments and asset issuance, with Soroban smart contracts written in Rust.

audits.title: Acurast Chain
audits.summary: Audit of the Acurast Substrate chain in Rust, covering the compute, marketplace, processor manager, rewards treasury and Hyperdrive pallets, P-256 crypto and the mainnet runtime. Acurast is a decentralized compute network powered by phones.

audits.title: VNX Protocol
audits.summary: Audit of the VNX Protocol Solana program, written in Rust. VNX provides B2B tokenization infrastructure for real-world assets, including token generation, smart contract configuration, blockchain connectivity and technical reporting.

audits.title: Dora Factory's Vota Sponsor Module
audits.summary: Audit of the x/sponsor-contract-tx module of Dora Factory's Vota chain, written in Go. It lets CosmWasm contracts sponsor transaction fees for their users, with per-user grant limits, an optional check_policy eligibility query and admin-managed sponsor funds.

audits.title: StylusPort
audits.summary: Review of the StylusPort handbook, code examples and MCP server, written in Rust. StylusPort is a framework and toolkit that streamlines the migration of SVM and Solana programs to Arbitrum Stylus smart contracts.

audits.title: Thema Protocol
audits.summary: Audit of the Thema core Solidity contracts. Thema is a DeFi protocol for issuing asset-backed tokens (OMTs) that are minted and redeemed atomically against configured asset baskets, with NAV tracked via oracle inputs and modular fee, oracle and token set interfaces.

audits.title: Meteora DAMM v2
audits.summary: Audit of the Meteora DAMM v2 program, a Rust smart contract on Solana. Meteora is a Solana DeFi project offering dynamic vaults for stable assets.

audits.title: Impossible Cloud Network Fairdrop
audits.summary: Audit of the Impossible Cloud Network Fairdrop Solidity contract, which distributes ICN tokens across three allocation tiers with a default 7-step or fast 2-step vesting schedule, role-based administration and time-windowed claims.

audits.title: AllUnity
audits.summary: Audit of the AllUnity Solidity contracts: an ERC-20 token with ERC-1363 and permit support, a blacklist manager and an ERC-1967 proxy, governed by admin, pauser, minter, burner and blacklister roles. AllUnity issues regulated, 1:1 fiat-backed stablecoins.

audits.title: MetaMask Card Baanx Withdraw Program
audits.summary: Audit of the MetaMask Card Baanx Withdraw program, an Anchor program on Solana that lets an authorized operator withdraw tokens to a beneficiary and distribute treasury funds via signed multi-send, supporting SPL Token and Token-2022.

audits.title: Polkadot micro-sr25519
audits.summary: Audit of micro-sr25519, a TypeScript implementation of the sr25519 signature scheme used in the Polkadot ecosystem, covering Schnorr signatures over Ristretto, hierarchical deterministic key derivation (hard and soft) and VRF outputs with proofs.

audits.title: Babylon
audits.summary: Audit of Babylon Genesis, a Cosmos SDK chain written in Go, together with its finality provider and Vigilante relayer. Babylon provides Bitcoin timestamping and Bitcoin staking, letting BTC holders secure Proof-of-Stake networks with slashing enforced through EOTS.

audits.title: NodeOps Network
audits.summary: Audit of the NodeOps Network Solidity contracts built around the NODE token, including multi-pool staking, revenue management with a burn pool, a revenue vault, cliff and linear vesting, and an airdrop, all upgradeable via UUPS proxies.

audits.title: Gno.land Chain Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to GnoVM, focused on allocation, preprocessing and value handling in the gnolang package. Gno is a deterministic, interpreted implementation of Go for smart contracts, and gno.land is the Proof of Contribution chain built on it.

audits.title: Capricorn (aPriori) APR Token and Staked APR Token
audits.summary: Audit of the APR Token and Staked APR Solidity contracts by Capricorn (aPriori): an upgradeable ERC20 token and an upgradeable tokenized vault with cooldown-based redemptions and linearly vesting rewards.

audits.title: Fuel Sequencer Updates (September 2025)
audits.summary: Audit of a round of updates to the Fuel Sequencer, a Cosmos SDK chain written in Go. Fuel Ignition is an Ethereum layer-2 rollup powered by the FuelVM.

audits.title: Structured Jupiter

audits.title: DATA Network (Story Protocol) 1.2

audits.title: Talus Network IAO
audits.summary: Audit of the Talus IAO Move contracts on Sui and their bonding curve, oracle, fixed-point math and governance utilities. Talus is an onchain platform for AI agents, with Nexus as its developer framework for building them.

audits.title: Silo MEV for SEI chain

audits.title: peaq EVM Precompile

audits.title: Swap.io CLMM

audits.title: Talus Network

audits.title: DATA Network (Story Protocol) Guardians
audits.summary: Audit of the Guardians module of the DATA Network (formerly Story Protocol) Geth client, written in Go. The DATA Network is an open protocol where human data is sourced, proven and processed to train AI models.

audits.title: Snowfork Snowbridge Updates 4
audits.summary: Audit of updates to Snowbridge's Solidity contracts and related Polkadot SDK pull requests. Snowbridge is a trustless bridge between Polkadot and Ethereum, using a BEEFY light client in Solidity and an Altair-compliant Beacon Chain light client in a Substrate pallet.

audits.title: KILT Bonding Curve Pallet
audits.summary: Audit of the KILT Bonding Curve Pallet, a Rust Substrate pallet in kilt-node that mints and burns tokens along a predefined bonding curve so prices adjust with supply and demand, with support for different curve formulas.

audits.title: Hippo Protocol (Hippocrat)

audits.title: Dymension Dymint
audits.summary: Audit of Dymint, the Go ABCI client implementation for Dymension's autonomous RollApps, which can replace CometBFT or Tendermint in any ABCI-compatible blockchain application. Dymension L1 is a decentralized chain launchpad.

audits.title: Composable Finance Solidity IBC Implementation
audits.summary: Audit of Composable Finance's implementation of IBC as a Solidity library. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure, with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Composable Finance Solana Light Client
audits.summary: Audit of the Composable Finance Solana light client, a WASM light client written in Rust for IBC connectivity with Solana. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure, with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Persistence Cosmos Liquid Staking Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to Persistence's Cosmos liquid staking functionality, implemented as Cosmos SDK modules written in Go.

audits.title: Persistence Dexter Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to the Persistence Dexter CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust.

audits.title: Router Voyager Forwarder Extension
audits.summary: Audit of the Router Voyager asset forwarder contracts (excluding DexSpan), the asset forwarder middleware and the CosmWasm gateway contract. Router Protocol provides cross-chain liquidity and interoperability with chain abstraction.

audits.title: Timewave Covenants
audits.summary: Audit of the Timewave Covenants CosmWasm contracts, including single- and two-party POL covenants and holders, swap covenants, liquid poolers for Astroport and Osmosis, IBC forwarders, routers, splitters and a Stride liquid staker. Timewave builds tools for long-term permissionless cooperation.

audits.title: Yieldmos Outposts Osmosis
audits.summary: Audit of the Yieldmos osmodca and osmostake outpost CosmWasm contracts on Osmosis. The Osmodca Outpost lets users set how much liquid OSMO each execution uses and how often it runs, authorizing it via the authz module so Yieldmos can manage delegators' rewards.

audits.title: Bifrost Finance
audits.summary: Audit of Bifrost Finance Leveraged Staking, covering the lend-market, leverage-staking and prices Substrate pallets in Rust. Bifrost is a staking yield layer that provides multi-chain liquid staking rewards infrastructure.

audits.title: Persistence Dexter
audits.summary: Audit of Dexter Core, the multi-staking and router contracts, and an emergency pause feature, in CosmWasm. Dexter is a DEX on Persistence built as a generalized state transition executor that queries swap math from its pool contracts for aggregated, non-custodial liquidity.

audits.title: Astroport Transmuter Pool
audits.summary: Audit of the Astroport Transmuter Pool CosmWasm contract and related factory changes. The transmuter implements a constant sum pair that swaps assets at a 1:1 ratio without spread or fees. Astroport is an AMM/DEX for swapping and providing liquidity.

audits.title: Persistence IBC Liquid Staking module
audits.summary: Audit of the Persistence IBC liquid staking module, a Cosmos SDK module written in Go.

audits.title: Zodiac Protocol Extension
audits.summary: Audit of all changes to Zodiac Protocol's core CosmWasm contracts since the previous audit. Zodiac is an open-source protocol on Osmosis for deconstructing LP positions into principal and yield tokens.

audits.title: Persistence Cosmos LSM
audits.summary: Audit of the Persistence Cosmos LSM functionality, implemented as a Cosmos SDK module written in Go.

audits.title: Neptune Protocol Update
audits.summary: Audit of changes to the Neptune Protocol CosmWasm contracts since a previous audit, including the market contract and the neptune-auth repository, excluding leverage trading and swap features. Neptune Finance is a lending and borrowing protocol.

audits.title: Snowfork Snowbridge Extension
audits.summary: Audit of changes to Snowbridge's Solidity contracts and Substrate parachain code since a previous audit. Snowbridge is a trustless bridge between Polkadot and Ethereum, using a Solidity BEEFY light client and an Altair-compliant Ethereum light client pallet.

audits.title: Vectis
audits.summary: Audit of the Vectis CosmWasm smart contracts across the vectis, vectis-contracts and vectis-authenticators repositories, including the factory contract that creates wallets. Vectis is developed by Nymlab.

audits.title: Timewave Computer Valence Services
audits.summary: Audit of the Timewave Computer Valence Services CosmWasm smart contracts, including the auctions manager. Timewave builds tools for digital organizations to engage in long-term permissionless cooperation.

audits.title: Noble TokenFactory and FiatTokenFactory modules
audits.summary: Audit of the Noble fiattokenfactory module and recent changes to its tokenfactory module, which enable minting of generic assets controlled by asset issuers. Noble is an application-specific Cosmos SDK blockchain purpose-built for native asset issuance.

audits.title: Composable Finance Ethereum Light Client
audits.summary: Audit of the Composable Finance Ethereum light client, a WASM light client written in Go for IBC on Cosmos SDK chains. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure, with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Router Voyager DexSpan
audits.summary: Audit of the Router DexSpan Solidity smart contracts in the evm/src/dexspan directory of Router's asset forwarder contracts. Router Protocol provides cross-chain liquidity and interoperability with chain abstraction.

audits.title: Router Voyager Forwarder
audits.summary: Audit of the Router Voyager Forwarder, the off-chain Go component of Router Protocol that relays messages between chains. Router is a layer one chain focused on blockchain interoperability, enabling cross-chain communication.

audits.title: Cosmos SDK v0.47
audits.summary: Audit of selected Cosmos SDK changes between v0.45.16-ics-lsm and v0.47.4 used in Gaia, covering baseapp, post handlers, store, math and the gov, auth, authz, consensus and upgrade modules. Cosmos SDK is an open-source framework for building Proof-of-Stake blockchains.

audits.title: XCVM Cosmwasm Contracts
audits.summary: Peer review of Composable Finance's XCVM CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure, with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Noble Circle's CCTP
audits.summary: Audit of Noble's integration of Circle's CCTP for USDC, implemented as a Cosmos SDK module written in Go. Noble builds stablecoin infrastructure for the world.

audits.title: Prism Osmosis LP Staking
audits.summary: Audit of the Prism Osmosis LP staking CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust.

audits.title: Lido Neutron Satellite
audits.summary: Audit of the Lido Satellite CosmWasm smart contract on Neutron, which mints and burns tokens through the tokenfactory module. The contract is developed by Hadron Labs.

audits.title: Snowfork Snowbridge
audits.summary: Audit of Snowbridge, Snowfork's bridge between Ethereum and Polkadot, covering the Solidity contracts, including the BEEFY light client that tracks the Polkadot relay chain, and the Substrate pallets that track Ethereum and carry bridge governance.

audits.title: Mars Red Bank Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to the Mars Red Bank CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust, covering all changes and their integration since a previous audit of the Mars Outposts codebase.

audits.title: SSZ RS Library
audits.summary: Audit of ssz-rs, a Rust implementation of SimpleSerialize (SSZ), the serialization method used on the Ethereum Beacon Chain. SSZ combines a deterministic serialization scheme with a Merkleization scheme designed to work efficiently with the serialized data.

audits.title: Composable Centauri
audits.summary: Security review of the Composable Centauri Cosmos SDK chain, covering the app and the mint and transfermiddleware modules in Go. Composable Finance builds cross-chain DeFi infrastructure, with trustless interoperability powered by IBC.

audits.title: Fairblock FairyRing
audits.summary: Audit of the Fairblock FairyRing Cosmos SDK chain. FairyRing lets users submit transactions encrypted with a public key that are decrypted and executed at a specified height, using a unique private key per block to prevent front-running.

audits.title: Polkadot GrandPa IBC Light Client
audits.summary: Audit of Composable Finance's Polkadot GrandPa IBC light client, a WASM light client written in Rust and Go that connects Polkadot and Cosmos chains over IBC.

audits.title: Zodiac Protocol
audits.summary: Audit of Zodiac Protocol's core CosmWasm smart contracts written in Rust. Zodiac is an open-source protocol on Osmosis for deconstructing LP positions into principal and yield tokens.

audits.title: Noble Tariff module
audits.summary: Audit of the Noble x/tariff Cosmos SDK module and its app integration. The module runs before the distribution module at the beginning of each block, collecting a percentage of newly minted inflation and distributing it among configured entities.

audits.title: Evmos Solidity Precompiles
audits.summary: Audit of the Evmos precompiles and related changes to Evmos and its go-ethereum fork. These EVM extensions are custom precompiled contracts that, unlike go-ethereum's built-in precompiles, can read and modify state and access Cosmos SDK functionality.

audits.title: DAODAO's Polytone
audits.summary: Audit of the Polytone CosmWasm smart contracts, which carry execute and query messages over IBC from a controller chain to a controlled chain. Polytone comes from DAO DAO, a platform for creating and managing DAOs across Cosmos.

audits.title: Cosmos Interchain Security
audits.summary: Audit of the Cosmos Interchain Security repository. Interchain Security lets a provider chain such as the Cosmos Hub secure consumer chains by sharing its validator set, with validators running nodes on both chains and earning fees and rewards on each.

audits.title: Membrane Finance
audits.summary: Audit of the Membrane Finance CosmWasm contracts for auctions, collateralized debt positions, the liquidation queue, liquidity checks, the oracle and the stability pool. Membrane is a protocol that uses collateralized debt positions to issue the CDT debt token across the Cosmos.

audits.title: Astroport Maker and Vesting Contracts
audits.summary: Audit of the changes to Astroport's Maker and Vesting tokenomics contracts, written in Rust with CosmWasm, since a previous review. Astroport is an automated market maker and decentralized exchange where users swap tokens and provide liquidity.

audits.title: IBCX Interchain Index Token
audits.summary: Audit of the IBCX smart contracts, written in Rust with CosmWasm, with all contracts in the many-things/ibcx-contracts repository in scope. IBCX is an index token for the Cosmos ecosystem.

audits.title: Astroport Concentrated Liquidity Pair
audits.summary: Audit of Astroport's concentrated liquidity pool contract, written in Rust with CosmWasm. Astroport implements an automated, decentralized exchange protocol in the Cosmos ecosystem where users swap tokens and provide liquidity.

audits.title: Neptune Protocol
audits.summary: Audit of the Neptune Protocol CosmWasm contracts, excluding the leverage trading feature, along with the neptune-auth and neptune-common Rust libraries. Neptune Finance is a lending and borrowing protocol that uses a PID controller to set its rates.

audits.title: Fuzion Plasma OTC
audits.summary: Audit of the Fuzion Plasma OTC CosmWasm contracts. Fuzion Plasma OTC is a protocol on the Kujira chain for public and private over-the-counter coin swaps, with options such as an arbiter, vesting accounts and partial swaps.

audits.title: Noble
audits.summary: Security review of the Noble chain, built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint in Go, centered on its TokenFactory module, which lets privileged accounts mint and control generic assets. Noble is designed to run on Interchain Security provided by the Cosmos Hub.

audits.title: Mars Protocol Rover Updates
audits.summary: Audit of updates to Mars Rover, a generalized credit protocol built on the Mars lending market. The review covers new account-nft and credit-manager features such as delisting logic and vault pricing changes, plus a new zapper contract that provides Osmosis liquidity for auto-compounding vaults.

audits.title: Filecoin FEVM Solidity Library
audits.summary: Audit of the Filecoin Solidity library, which gives Solidity smart contracts on the Filecoin EVM an API for calling methods on Filecoin built-in actors and accessing Filecoin-specific syscalls.

audits.title: Filecoin FEVM
audits.summary: Audit of the Filecoin EVM (FEVM), an Ethereum Virtual Machine compatible runtime virtualized on top of the Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM), covering the builtin-actors and ref-fvm repositories. Filecoin is a decentralized storage network.

audits.title: Nym Mixnet and Vesting Contracts
audits.summary: Audit of Nym's mixnet and vesting CosmWasm contracts, written in Rust, and their relevant imports. The mixnet contract handles epoch advancement, mixnode rewards and layer assignments for the mixnet. Nym builds privacy technology, including NymVPN, a decentralized VPN based on its mixnet.

audits.title: Autonomy Network Osmosis
audits.summary: Audit of the Autonomy Network registry-stake and wrapper-osmosis CosmWasm contracts. Autonomy Network is a decentralized automation protocol that lets users have on-chain transactions executed automatically in the future under arbitrary conditions.

audits.title: Mars Protocol Rover
audits.summary: Audit of the Mars Rover account-nft, credit-manager, oracle-adapter and swapper CosmWasm contracts. Mars Rovers are isolated credit accounts where users aggregate DeFi activity under a single liquidation LTV, represented by transferable NFTs.

audits.title: Persistence Cosmos Liquid Staking
audits.summary: Audit of the x/lscosmos Cosmos SDK module in Persistence's pstake-native codebase, written in Go. The module powers stkATOM, a non-custodial ATOM liquid staking solution on the Persistence Core-1 chain.

audits.title: Nolus Money Market
audits.summary: Audit of the Nolus Money Market CosmWasm contracts: treasury, dispatcher, timealarms, lpp, leaser, oracle, profit and lease. Nolus Money Market is a lending protocol on the Nolus chain that lets users lend and borrow assets and NLS token holders earn protocol fees.

audits.title: Nolus Core
audits.summary: Audit of the mint and tax Cosmos SDK modules of the Nolus chain, written in Go. Nolus Protocol is a DeFi suite offering money markets with a lease solution for leveraged positions with fixed borrowing costs.

audits.title: Comdex Lend and Liquidation modules
audits.summary: Audit of the x/lend and x/liquidation Cosmos SDK modules of the Comdex chain, written in Go. Comdex aims to provide an infrastructure layer for creating and deploying DeFi applications in the Cosmos ecosystem.

audits.title: Injective wasmx module and CosmWasm bindings
audits.summary: Audit of Injective's wasmx Cosmos SDK module, the registry CosmWasm contract, the CosmWasm bindings and the MsgExec implementation in the exchange module. Injective is an open, interoperable smart contract platform for decentralized financial applications.

audits.title: Neutron
audits.summary: Audit of the Neutron chain, built with the Cosmos SDK in Go, together with its CosmWasm bindings and example contracts. Neutron brings CosmWasm smart contracts to Cosmos, uses IBC Interchain Accounts for cross-chain queries and transactions, and is secured by the Cosmos Hub through Interchain Security.

audits.title: Mars Protocol Outposts
audits.summary: Audit of the Mars Protocol outposts CosmWasm contracts, written in Rust. Mars is a money market protocol, and the audited contracts implement it on the Osmosis blockchain.

audits.title: Mars Protocol Periphery
audits.summary: Audit of the Mars Protocol periphery smart contracts, written in Rust with CosmWasm and intended for deployment on Mars Hub, part of the Mars ecosystem.

audits.title: Comdex Vesting & Locking Contracts
audits.summary: Audit of the Comdex Locking and Vesting CosmWasm contracts. The Locking contract powers the Comdex chain's ve governance model, with locked tokens represented as NFTs, and handles token emission and distribution, while the Vesting contract provides periodic and linear token vesting.

audits.title: Prism Auto Compounding Staking
audits.summary: Audit of the Prism Hub CosmWasm contract of Prism Auto Compounding cAsset, which handles protocol operations for users and administrators. The protocol lets users delegate coins to validators with liquid staking and automatic compounding of rewards.

audits.title: Elesto Mint Module
audits.summary: Audit of the Elesto mint module, a Cosmos SDK module written in Go.

audits.title: Margined Protocol Perpetuals
audits.summary: Audit of the Margined Protocol Perpetuals CosmWasm contracts: the margin engine, fee pool, insurance fund, price feed and a virtual automated market maker (vAMM). Margined is a decentralized perpetuals protocol with multichain margin engines for CosmWasm-enabled blockchains.

audits.title: Comdex Chain & Comdex Governance Contract
audits.type: Cosmos SDK and CosmWasm Contract Audit
audits.summary: Audit of the Comdex chain's Cosmos SDK modules, including asset, vault, locker, collector, rewards, auction, tokenmint, bandoracle, market, liquidity and esm, plus the Comdex CosmWasm governance contracts, reviewed in three stages. Comdex is an infrastructure layer for DeFi applications in Cosmos.

audits.title: CosmWasm Wasmd Module
audits.summary: Audit of wasmd, the Cosmos SDK module written in Go that integrates the wasmvm virtual machine to run CosmWasm smart contracts. CosmWasm is a smart contract platform for Cosmos SDK blockchains focused on security, performance and interoperability.

audits.title: Stargaze Marketplace
audits.summary: Audit of the Stargaze marketplace CosmWasm contracts. Stargaze is a Cosmos zone dedicated to NFTs, and its marketplace, owned by chain governance, lets users buy and sell NFTs through auctions and direct offers.

audits.title: Subsea (Risk Harbor) Ozone v2
audits.summary: Audit of the Ozone v2 CosmWasm contracts of Subsea (formerly Risk Harbor) on Terra. Risk Harbor is a DeFi risk management marketplace that protects liquidity providers and stakers against smart contract risks, hacks and attacks through an automated, impartial claims process.

audits.title: Aperture Finance 2
audits.summary: Audit of Aperture's contracts on Terra: an Anchor Protocol proxy, delta-neutral position and manager contracts, a Terra manager that uses Wormhole for cross-chain strategies, and an Ethereum-side Solidity contract. Aperture aggregates investment opportunities across blockchains.

audits.title: Levana Perpetual Swap
audits.summary: Audit of the Levana Perpetual Swaps CosmWasm contracts and the shared levana-common code. Levana Perpetual Swaps enables leveraged trading of any asset without a counterparty, with trades that are always executable and have no expiration date.

audits.title: C2X Com2Us
audits.summary: Audit of C2X CosmWasm contracts in the Terra ecosystem: a legacy cw20 token implementation, an NFT lock system and a beta game launcher that lets users support sales of newly launched games. C2X is a blockchain gaming platform.

audits.title: Kinetic Money
audits.summary: Audit of the Kinetic Money CosmWasm contracts for the vault, phaser, Anchor adapter, coordinator and protocol tokens. Kinetic Money is a protocol on Terra where users deposit funds in return for a self-repaying loan, with deposit yield used to reduce the debt.
